description: Codex: Space Marines (11e) Devastator Brethren enhancement MASTER-FORGED FIREARMS (WP-M2b): the bearer model's ranged attacks (excluding [PSYCHIC]) have +1 A, S, AP and D; and Ironclad Champions' VENERABLE CHAMPION (AURA): friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY/MOUNTED units within 6" of the bearer Dreadnought re-roll hit rolls of 1. Fixture sm11e_m2b_marines_active (Lieutenant with Combi-weapon carries Master-forged Firearms, 5.7" from the Ballistus Dreadnought, which carries Venerable Champion). Setup privileges: CP 0 for both, the Meganobz (W3) placed ~11" from the Lieutenant, straight to the Shooting phase. The shooting panel's unit pick selects the Lieutenant; SHOOT sends the Combi-weapon – Bolter (A2 S5 AP-1 D1, [RAPID FIRE 1]) at the Meganobz: the to_hit block rolls 4 dice (2 + 1 Master-forged + 1 rapid fire) and its ledger names Venerable Champion (re-roll 1s); the Game Log save line reads AP -2, and no Meganob is left on 2 wounds (every unsaved attack deals 2 damage).
